dialogues.speaker: Pixica
dialogues.text: Fancy taking on the Floating Target Balloons? No advanced flying techniques required. Anyone can try it out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't I need some kind of flying license or anything?

dialogues.speaker: Pixica
dialogues.text: No no no, even someone like me, who could never get his flying license, can still complete this with ease.

dialogues.speaker: Pixica
dialogues.text: Rather than your flying skills, what this tests is your shooting ability.

dialogues.speaker: Pixica
dialogues.text: The most important thing is to focus! Concentrate single-mindedly on your target.

dialogues.speaker: Pixica
dialogues.text: Miss Zyanya will ensure your safety throughout your experience, and you'll sometimes even be able to see a Qucusaurus patrolling nearby!

dialogues.speaker: Pixica
dialogues.text: Hot air balloons... What a magnificent invention, bringing humanity closer to the skies.
